description:
A source-first Grok Archive Hub evidence video explaining why disputed public interpretations of Todd Blanche's hearing answer should not be reduced to either a blanket exoneration claim or an all-purpose proof claim.

This draft package is based on the GAH evidence brief, official Senate source material, the quote-verification ledger, records-versus-proof matrix, prosecution-decision ledger, and acquisition-gap tracker. It separates official caption source, GAH hearing-exchange summary, human-certified short quotation, and editorial interpretation.

Related GAH sources:
- Evidence brief: https://grokarchivehub.com/evidence-briefs/todd-blanche-no-evidence
- Source manifest: https://grokarchivehub.com/evidence-data/blanche-no-evidence/source-manifest.json
- Claims ledger: https://grokarchivehub.com/evidence-data/blanche-no-evidence/claims.json
- Corrections: https://grokarchivehub.com/corrections

No person is accused of criminal conduct in this video unless the cited primary record establishes the procedural posture. Charges, allegations, testimony, leads, association records, and court findings are separated by label.
